email.title: Sign in with an email code
email.description: Enter the email address of your SiiPet account. SiiPet sends a sign-in code to this address.

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Enter the code that SiiPet sent to {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to SiiPet. Try again later.
error.code_request_failed: SiiPet did not send a code. Check the email address and try again.
error.invalid_code: The code is not correct or it expired.
error.login_failed: SiiPet rejected the sign-in. Close this form and start again to get a new code.
error.session_rejected: SiiPet accepted the code, but rejected the new session. Close this form and start again to get a new code.
error.too_many_requests: SiiPet allows only a few code requests per day. Try again tomorrow.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Read the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This SiiPet account is already configured.
abort.entry_outdated: This SiiPet entry is from an old version. Remove the SiiPet entry and add it again.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same SiiPet account as before.

init.title: Local media
init.description: Home Assistant can keep a copy of the SiiPet recordings and images of recent days, and play them from this copy. Set 0 to turn the copy off and delete it.

data_description.media_days: From 0 to 30. A recording takes about 30 MB on average. The copy is in the folder .siipet of the media folder.

media_disk_full.title: SiiPet paused the local media copy
media_disk_full.description: The disk of the media folder has less than 1 GB free, so SiiPet stopped copying recordings and images. Recordings and images that are not copied yet play from the SiiPet cloud until space is free again. Free some space, or set fewer days in the SiiPet options.

media_folder_unavailable.title: SiiPet cannot use the media folder
media_folder_unavailable.description: SiiPet cannot write its local copy of recordings and images to the media folder, so playback uses the SiiPet cloud. Check the media folder, then reload the SiiPet integration. To stop the local copy, set 0 days in the SiiPet options.

entry_outdated.message: Remove the SiiPet entry and add it again.

not_loaded.message: SiiPet is not loaded. Check the SiiPet integration.

request_failed.message: SiiPet could not complete the request: {error}

visit_not_in_window.message: SiiPet has no visit {event_id} in the last 7 days.

nothing_to_change.message: The visit already matches the request.

type_required.message: The visit has an unknown type. Choose a type together with the cats.

edit_partial.message: SiiPet may not have applied the whole change to visit {event_id}: {error}. Check the visit, then call the action again with type {type}.

edit_partial_note.message: SiiPet may not have saved the memo of visit {event_id}: {error}. Check the visit, then call the action again.

edit_unconfirmed.message: SiiPet accepted the change to visit {event_id}, but the visit could not be read back: {error}. Check the visit in the SiiPet app.

edit_not_applied.message: SiiPet did not apply the change to visit {event_id}. Check the visit in the SiiPet app.

control_failed.message: SiiPet did not accept the change. It may be offline; try again.

list_visits.name: List visits
list_visits.description: Returns the litter box visits of up to 7 days, newest first. The response holds no links.

date.name: Date
date.description: The last day to list. Today or one of the 30 days before it. Default: today.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to list, ending on the date. 1 to 7. Default: 1.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: List only the visits of this cat. The Unknown cat lists unrecognized visits.

update_visit.name: Update visit
update_visit.description: Changes the cats, the type, or the memo of a litter box visit.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The event_id of the visit, from the List visits response or a Visit event.

cats.name: Cats
cats.description: The cats that used the box. The Unknown cat is not valid here.

type.name: Type
type.description: The new type of the visit.

note.name: Memo
note.description: The new memo, up to 200 characters. An empty memo clears it.

delete_visit.name: Delete visit
delete_visit.description: Deletes a litter box visit for good. You cannot undo it.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The event_id of the visit, from the List visits response or a Visit event.
